parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Eliminate $y$: $kx^2-4x+k=0$ (**M1**). For no intersection, use $b^2-4ac<0$: $(-4)^2-4k^2<0$ (**M1**). Hence $k<-2$ or $k>2$ (**A1**, cao; allow interval notation).
